name: Application Meeting Approval Criteria (Happy Path)
description: Applicant with high income ($7,500), excellent credit score (785), and conservative requested amount ($15,000). DTI evaluates to 6.0%. DMN evaluates to Approved.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_LoanApplied -> Task_ValidateApplicant -> Gateway_Validation (Valid) -> Task_CreditAssessment -> Task_EvaluateLoanDmn -> Gateway_DmnOutcome (Approved) -> Task_PrepareDisbursement -> Task_NotifyApproved -> EndEvent_Approved

name: Application Failing Eligibility Criteria (Adverse Action)
description: Applicant with low income ($1,800), high requested loan ($45,000), resulting in extreme DTI (>70%) and poor credit score (540). DMN evaluates to Rejected.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_LoanApplied -> Task_ValidateApplicant -> Gateway_Validation (Valid) -> Task_CreditAssessment -> Task_EvaluateLoanDmn -> Gateway_DmnOutcome (Rejected) -> Task_NotifyRejected -> EndEvent_Rejected

name: Application Requiring Manual Review (Tasklist User Task)
description: Applicant with moderate income ($4,500), requested amount ($22,000), fair credit score (675), and borderline DTI (38.8%). DMN evaluates to Manual Review.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_LoanApplied -> Task_ValidateApplicant -> Gateway_Validation (Valid) -> Task_CreditAssessment -> Task_EvaluateLoanDmn -> Gateway_DmnOutcome (Manual Review) -> Task_ManualUnderwriterReview (Tasklist) -> Gateway_UnderwriterDecision (Approved) -> Task_PrepareDisbursement -> Task_NotifyApproved -> EndEvent_Approved

name: Credit Assessment API Error / Outage Handling
description: Simulates external credit bureau downtime returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable. Triggered via applicantId 'SIMULATE_ERROR'.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_LoanApplied -> Task_ValidateApplicant -> Gateway_Validation (Valid) -> Task_CreditAssessment [HTTP 503 / Zeebe Incident] -> Incident Resolved -> Complete

name: Worker Failure Followed by Correction and Recovery
description: Applicant with invalid monthlyIncome (-500) and simulateWorkerFailure flag enabled. Worker raises IllegalArgumentException. Operator edits variable to $4,800 in Operate and retries job.
expectedRoute: StartEvent_LoanApplied -> Task_ValidateApplicant [INCIDENT: IllegalArgumentException] -> Operate Diagnostic -> Variable Modified to monthlyIncome=4800, simulateWorkerFailure=false -> Retry Job in Operate -> Resume to Completion
